shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- files ---'; rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g 'package.json' -g 'next.config.*' -g 'app/**' -g 'src/**' | sed -n '1,240p'; printf '%s\\n' '--- package ---'; cat package.json; printf '%s\\n' '--- git status ---'; git status --short"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- AGENTS ---'; cat AGENTS.md; printf '%s\\n' '--- config ---'; cat next.config.ts; for f in app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx app/loading.tsx app/RevenueChart.tsx app/LatestInvoices.tsx app/CardStats.tsx; do printf '\\n--- %s ---\\n' \""'$f"; sed -n '"'1,260p' \""'$f"; done; printf '"'%s\\n' '--- relevant docs ---'; find node_modules/next/dist/docs -type f | rg -i 'partial|ppr|cache-components|suspense|loading' | sed -n '1,160p'"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- docs index matches ---'; rg -l 'Partial Prerender|partial prerender|Cache Components|use cache|uncached data' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app | sed -n '1,200p'; printf '%s\\n' '--- package version ---'; node -p \"require('./node_modules/next/package.json').version\""

/bin/bash -lc "for f in \\
 node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/05-config/01-next-config-js/cacheComponents.md \\
 node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/08-caching.md \\
 node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/06-fetching-data.md \\
 node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/streaming.md \\
 node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/01-directives/use-cache.md \\
 node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/loading.md; do printf '\\n===== %s =====\\n' \""'$f"; sed -n '"'1,280p' \""'$f"; done'

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- caching headings ---'; rg -n '"'^##|''^###|Suspense|static shell|uncached|fetch'"' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/08-caching.md | sed -n '1,240p'; printf '%s\\n' '--- fetching headings ---'; rg -n '"'^##|''^###|Suspense|parallel|sequential|preload|fetch'"' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/06-fetching-data.md | sed -n '1,260p'; printf '%s\\n' '--- use cache headings ---'; rg -n '"'^##|''^###|fetch|cacheLife|arguments|return'"' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/01-directives/use-cache.md | sed -n '1,220p'; printf '%s\\n' '--- streaming headings ---'; rg -n '"'^##|''^###|sequential|parallel|Suspense'"' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/streaming.md | sed -n '1,220p'"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '90,155p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/08-caching.md; sed -n '430,610p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/streaming.md; rg -n 'memoiz|dedup|React cache|cache\\(' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/06-fetching-data.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/08-caching.md | sed -n '1,180p'; git diff -- tsconfig.json; git status --short"
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff -- app/page.tsx app/CardStats.tsx app/RevenueChart.tsx app/LatestInvoices.tsx; npx tsc --noEmit'

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- emitted app files ---'; find .next/server/app -maxdepth 3 -type f | sort | sed -n '1,160p'; printf '%s\\n' '--- shell markers ---'; rg -n -o 'Dashboard|Total Revenue|Total Invoices|Revenue|Latest Invoices|Loading dashboard|Loading revenue|Loading invoices' .next/server/app .next/server/chunks 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1,120p'; printf '%s\\n' '--- changed files ---'; git status --short; printf '%s\\n' '--- diff stat ---'; git diff --stat; printf '%s\\n' '--- tsconfig diff ---'; git diff -- tsconfig.json"

/bin/bash -lc "apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: tsconfig.json
@@
-    \"lib\": [
-      \"dom\",
-      \"dom.iterable\",
-      \"esnext\"
-    ],
+    \"lib\": [\"dom\", \"dom.iterable\", \"esnext\"],
@@
-    \"paths\": {
-      \"@/*\": [
-        \"./*\"
-      ]
-    }
+    \"paths\": {
+      \"@/*\": [\"./*\"]
+    }
   },
-  \"include\": [
-    \"next-env.d.ts\",
-    \"**/*.ts\",
-    \"**/*.tsx\",
-    \".next/types/**/*.ts\",
-    \".next/dev/types/**/*.ts\"
-  ],
-  \"exclude\": [
-    \"node_modules\"
-  ]
+  \"include\": [\"next-env.d.ts\", \"**/*.ts\", \"**/*.tsx\", \".next/types/**/*.ts\"],
+  \"exclude\": [\"node_modules\"]
 }
*** End Patch
PATCH
rm -rf .next next-env.d.ts tsconfig.tsbuildinfo
printf '%s\\n' '--- final status ---'
git status --short
printf '%s\\n' '--- task diff ---'
git diff -- app tsconfig.json"

/bin/bash -lc "git diff --check; printf '%s\\n' '--- line references ---'; for f in app/page.tsx app/dashboard-data.ts app/CardStats.tsx app/RevenueChart.tsx app/LatestInvoices.tsx; do printf '\\n%s\\n' \""'$f"; nl -ba "$f" | sed -n '"'1,140p'; done"
